tanoti.p: [Tanu+o+ti] (kri) CL=7 It stretches or it extends.

B:
tanoti： tanoti（kri）

[tanu+o+ti]

P: Tanoti，[*ten； cp．Sk．tanoti，Gr．tei/nw，tόnos，tέtanos； Lat．teneo，tenuis，tendo （E．ex-tend）； Goth．panjan； Ohg．denen； cp．also Sk．tanti，tāna，tantra] to stretch，extend； rare as finite verb，usually only in pp．tata．‹-› Pgdp 17．（Page 296）

tanoti：တနောတိ （√တန်）
ချဲ့၏။ ဖြန့်ချဲ့၏။
DOP: tanoti tanute pr. 3 sg. [ S. tanoti, tanute] ( see Sadd 506, 17 foll. ), stretches, extends ; Dhātup 519 (tana vitthāre); Dhātum 732; Vism 481, 26 (te ca āyabhūte dhamme etāni [āyatanāni] ~onti vitthārentī ti vuttaṃ hoti, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se ~anti); Pj II 24, 27 (vanaṃ tharati ~otī ti vanatho, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee omits tharati); Sadd 506, 1 (tanu vitthāre: ~oti āyatanaṃ tanū, kammani taniyyati); 825, 18 (tanādito oyirā: ~oti karoti); 834, 28 (uttam okāro … kurute karoti ~ute ~oti); — inf. tanituṃ, Sadd 506, 4 ; — absol. tanitvāna, Sadd 506, 4 ; — pass. pr. 3 sg. taniyyati, Sadd 506, 7 (tanū ti sarīraṃ taṃ hi kalalato paṭṭhāya kammādīhi yathāsambhavaṃ ~iyyati vitthārīyati mahattaṃ pāpīyatī ti); — pp tata , mfn. [ ts ], stretched, extended, spread out ; Abh 746 (visaṭaṃ vitthataṃ ~aṃ); Sn 357 (acchidā maccuno jālaṃ ~aṃ māyāvino daḷhaṃ; Pj II 351, 19 foll. : tebhūmakavaṭṭe vitthataṃ mārassa taṇhājālaṃ) ≠ Th 1277 ≠ Ja VI 46, 3* ( Be so; Ce, Ee, Se tantaṃ); Ja IV 484, 13* (~āni jālāni padāliya haṃsā, so read ? Ce, Ee tantāni; Be, Se katāni); V 341, 5* (pāsā bahuvidhā ~ā; 342, 30´ : ~ā ti vitatā oḍḍitā); — for samo tataṃ in Ee at Ja I 183, 26* read samotataṃ with Be, Ce .
